verdict.rationale: Incremental ingestion without a full reindex is evidenced: documents are added to an existing index (meilisearch-docs-74), and official integrations auto-sync database rows, ActiveRecord models and Firebase collections (meilisearch-docs-88, meilisearch-docs-85, meilisearch-docs-87). A long-running production user confirms continuous Postgres syncing works (meilisearch-comm-19). However, the docs never claim near-real-time visibility. Hands-on reports show indexing of frequently changing records falling hours behind (meilisearch-comm-9) and an early CPU-bound backlog that only batch indexing fixed (meilisearch-comm-15), though indexing speed has since improved (meilisearch-comm-7). Missing for 10: documented near-real-time latency for updates, explicit evidence that updates and deletes are applied incrementally, and independent corroboration that high-churn workloads stay current.
